title: The Killing of bin Laden’s Successor

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 即便是在黑胶唱片时代的夜店做 DJ 时，你每晚也要带着 300 件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，你把 DJ 台

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成了一个活生生的、快闪式的博物馆，陈列着那些精美的、有 50 年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼带来的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: My fellow Americans, on Saturday, at my direction, the United States successfully concluded an airstrike in Kabul, Afghanistan, to kill the emir of al-Qaeda,
sentences.zh: 各位美国同胞，周六，在我的指示下，美国在阿富汗喀布尔成功实施了一次空袭，击毙了基地组织的埃米尔，

sentences.en: Iman al-Zawiri.
sentences.zh: 艾曼·扎瓦希里。

sentences.en: On Monday, President Biden announced that the United States had just killed the leader of al-Qaeda, one of the key masterminds behind the September 11th attacks
sentences.zh: 周一，拜登总统宣布，美国刚刚击毙了基地组织领导人，他是“9·11”袭击的主要策划者之一，

sentences.en: in a drone strike in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 死于阿富汗的一次无人机空袭。

sentences.en: We make it clear again tonight that no matter how long it takes, no matter where you hide, if you are a threat to our people, the United States will find you and take you out.
sentences.zh: 我们今晚再次明确表示，无论需要多久，无论你们躲在哪里，只要你们对我们的人民构成威胁，美国就一定会找到你们并将你们铲除。

sentences.en: My colleague Eric Schmidt on Iman al-Zawahiri and what his death means for Afghanistan's relationship with the United States and for the threat of global terrorism.
sentences.zh: 我的同事埃里克·施密特将讲述艾曼·扎瓦希里其人，以及他的死对阿富汗与美国的关系，还有对全球恐怖主义威胁意味着什么。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, August 2nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是 8 月 2 日，星期二。

sentences.en: So, Eric, we're talking to you at 8.15 on Monday night.
sentences.zh: 埃里克，我们现在是周一晚上 8 点 15 分和你连线。

sentences.en: President Biden just finished a surprise address to the nation,
sentences.zh: 拜登总统刚刚发表了一次针对全国的突发讲话，

sentences.en: and he told us about a successful counterterrorism operation in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我们阿富汗境内进行了一次成功的反恐行动。

sentences.en: What do we need to know about this man,
sentences.zh: 关于这个人，我们有什么需要了解的吗？

sentences.en: Zawahiri?
sentences.zh: 扎瓦希里？

sentences.en: Well, first and foremost, what you need to know about Zawahiri was he succeeded Osama bin Laden when bin Laden was killed in a Navy SEAL raid in 2011.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先也是最重要的，你需要知道的是，扎瓦希里是在 2011 年奥萨马·本·拉登在海豹突击队突袭中被击毙后，接替了他的位置。

sentences.en: He was a long-time number two to bin Laden, but he was, more than that, he was also the intellectual spine for al-Qaeda.
sentences.zh: 他曾长期担任本·拉登的二把手，但不仅如此，他还是基地组织的思想支柱。

sentences.en: If you think of bin Laden as kind of the front man, who's the glitzy, glamorous guy who brought prestige and money to al-Qaeda,
sentences.zh: 如果你把本·拉登看作是门面人物，那个光鲜亮丽、为基地组织带来声望和资金的人，

sentences.en: Zawahiri was really the man who was the ideologue, who was the chief operating officer, if you will.
sentences.zh: 那么扎瓦希里就是真正的意识形态家，或者说是首席运营官。

sentences.en: And of this pair, he was really the more hard line of the two.
sentences.zh: 在这两人中，他确实是立场更强硬的那一个。

sentences.en: And how did he get drawn into Islamic politics and then to terrorism?
sentences.zh: 他是如何卷入伊斯兰政治并最终走向恐怖主义的？

sentences.en: So it's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有意思。

sentences.en: He was born in an upscale Cairo neighborhood, in Egypt, but was radicalized pretty early.
sentences.zh: 他出生在埃及开罗的一个高档社区，但很早就变得激进。

sentences.en: As a teenager, he was drawn to some of the very hard line conservative Islamic thinkers of the day.
sentences.zh: 十几岁时，他就被当时一些极其强硬的保守派伊斯兰思想家所吸引。

sentences.en: So he had this very political side of him.
sentences.zh: 所以他有非常政治化的一面。

sentences.en: But he was also starting classes at medical school.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，他开始在医学院上课。

sentences.en: He wanted to be a surgeon.
sentences.zh: 他想成为一名外科医生。

sentences.en: So he has this duality to him growing up.
sentences.zh: 所以他在成长过程中有着这种双重性。

sentences.en: And then by the early 1980s,
sentences.zh: 到了 20 世纪 80 年代初，

sentences.en: 1981 to be exact, he is involved in a plot to assassinate the president of Egypt,
sentences.zh: 确切地说是 1981 年，他参与了一场暗杀埃及总统的阴谋，

sentences.en: Anwar Sadat.
sentences.zh: 安瓦尔·萨达特。

sentences.en: And he's jailed for that and spends several years in jail before he's released.
sentences.zh: 他因此入狱，在获释前坐了几年的牢。

sentences.en: And then he's drawn back again into this very kind of hard line conservative Sunni Islam movement.
sentences.zh: 出狱后，他又被拉回了那种极其强硬的保守派逊尼派伊斯兰运动中。

sentences.en: And he finds himself in Pakistan in the late 80s.
sentences.zh: 80 年代末，他身处巴基斯坦。

sentences.en: And interestingly enough, bin Laden sometimes lectured at the hospital where Zawahiri worked in Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，本·拉登有时会在扎瓦希里工作的巴基斯坦医院里发表演讲。

sentences.en: And it was there, they struck up this friendship and Zawahiri became bin Laden's personal physician.
sentences.zh: 就在那里，他们建立了友谊，扎瓦希里成了本·拉登的私人医生。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: And helped bin Laden begin thinking about specific ways how, you know, to hurt the Western powers and the Middle Eastern governments that the West supported.
sentences.zh: 他帮助本·拉登开始思考如何以具体方式去伤害西方大国以及西方所支持的中东政府。

sentences.en: And the two of them become a very powerful pair.
sentences.zh: 两人从此成为了一对非常有权势的搭档。

sentences.en: And it's shortly after that that they form Al-Qaeda in the late 1980s.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，他们在 20 世纪 80 年代末组建了基地组织。

sentences.en: Okay, so bin Laden and Zawahiri found Al-Qaeda together.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以本·拉登和扎瓦希里共同创立了基地组织。

sentences.en: What was their plan?
sentences.zh: 他们的计划是什么？

sentences.en: What did they hope to accomplish?
sentences.zh: 他们希望实现什么目标？

sentences.en: So when they form Al-Qaeda, in many ways, their goal is to ultimately create a religious state by getting rid of the secular governments in their own region in places like Egypt,
sentences.zh: 当他们组建基地组织时，他们的目标在很大程度上是通过推翻埃及等地区国家的世俗政府，最终建立一个宗教国家，

sentences.en: but also driving out the Westerners, the Western troops that existed at the time in places like Saudi Arabia to drive them out as well.
sentences.zh: 同时也为了驱逐西方人，驱逐当时驻扎在沙特阿拉伯等地的西方军队。

sentences.en: And certainly by the mid-1990s,
sentences.zh: 到了 20 世纪 90 年代中期，

sentences.en: Zawahiri writes, you know, a very important document that's intended to kind of unite militant groups in the common cause of killing Americans anywhere.
sentences.zh: 扎瓦希里写了一份非常重要的文件，旨在团结各武装组织，共同实现“在任何地方杀害美国人”这一目标。

sentences.en: They're the ultimate infidel.
sentences.zh: 他们是终极异教徒。

sentences.en: And so I think it's there where you see
sentences.zh: 所以我认为正是从那时起，你看到了

sentences.en: Zawahiri, again, is this intellectual
sentences.zh: 扎瓦希里，再次强调，他是基地组织的思想

sentences.en: spine of Al-Qaeda basically giving religious justification for the killings of Americans and other Westerners.
sentences.zh: 支柱，基本上为杀害美国人和其他西方人提供了宗教正当性。

sentences.en: And what do they do?
sentences.zh: 他们做了什么？

sentences.en: What starts to happen?
sentences.zh: 开始发生了什么？

sentences.en: So they start setting up training camps to basically train fighters throughout the region, throughout North Africa, throughout the Middle East to carry out these goals.
sentences.zh: 他们开始建立训练营，基本上是为了在整个地区、整个北非、整个中东训练武装人员，以实现这些目标。

sentences.en: But they really get on everyone's radar in 1998 when they attack two United States embassies in East Africa, in Kenya and Tanzania, and kill more than 200 people
sentences.zh: 但他们真正进入大众视野是在 1998 年，当时他们袭击了美国驻东非肯尼亚和坦桑尼亚的两个大使馆，造成 200 多人死亡，

sentences.en: in these just brutal bombings.
sentences.zh: 在那场残酷的爆炸案中。

sentences.en: They're just stunning for their ferocity.
sentences.zh: 其残暴程度令人震惊。

sentences.en: And then two years later,
sentences.zh: 两年后，

sentences.en: Al-Qaeda struck again, this time bombing an American warship in Yemen, the USS Cole, killing 17 American sailors and wounding 40 others.
sentences.zh: 基地组织再次发动袭击，这次是在也门炸毁了一艘美国军舰“科尔号”，造成 17 名美国水兵死亡，40 人受伤。

sentences.en: Taken together, the embassy bombings and the attack on the USS Cole dramatically elevated
sentences.zh: 总的来说，大使馆爆炸案和对“科尔号”的袭击极大地提升了

sentences.en: Al-Qaeda's profile on the international terrorism scene.
sentences.zh: 基地组织在国际恐怖主义舞台上的地位。

sentences.en: And of course, their biggest attack is yet to come,
sentences.zh: 当然，他们最大的袭击还在后面，

sentences.en: September 11th, 2001.
And Zawahiri was a central plotter in this attack.
sentences.zh: 扎瓦希里是这次袭击的核心策划者。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So September 11th happens, and this is ultimately what leads the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以“9·11”事件发生了，这最终导致美国

sentences.en: to invade Afghanistan because the U.S.
sentences.zh: 入侵阿富汗，因为美国

sentences.en: said the Taliban in Afghanistan was harboring Al-Qaeda.
sentences.zh: 称阿富汗的塔利班窝藏了基地组织。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So the invasion happens in 2001.
sentences.zh: 所以 2001 年入侵发生了。

sentences.en: Al-Qaeda is driven out across into neighboring Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 基地组织被赶到了邻国巴基斯坦。

sentences.en: The Taliban government falls.
sentences.zh: 塔利班政府倒台了。

sentences.en: But Al-Qaeda is still very much active in these mountainous areas along the Afghan-Pakistan border.
sentences.zh: 但基地组织在阿富汗和巴基斯坦边境的山区依然非常活跃。

sentences.en: And they keep trying to carry out attacks into Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 他们不断试图对阿富汗发动袭击。

sentences.en: The United States carries out drone strikes for many years inside of Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 美国在巴基斯坦境内进行了多年的无人机空袭。

sentences.en: But as this fight is going on,
sentences.zh: 但在战斗进行的同时，

sentences.en: Al-Qaeda is successfully growing its brand.
sentences.zh: 基地组织成功地扩大了其品牌影响力。

sentences.en: It's spreading to different countries in Africa, in the Middle East, in Southwest Asia, to the point where it's really become an international terrorist organization.
sentences.zh: 它蔓延到非洲、中东和西南亚的不同国家，以至于它真正成为了一个国际恐怖组织。

sentences.en: Until finally, in 2011,
sentences.zh: 直到最后，在 2011 年，

sentences.en: Osama bin Laden is killed in the Navy SEAL raid.
sentences.zh: 奥萨马·本·拉登在海豹突击队的突袭中被击毙。

sentences.en: I remember that raid.
sentences.zh: 我记得那次突袭。

sentences.en: I remember that night and the photo of all of them, including, of course,
sentences.zh: 我记得那个夜晚，还有那张他们所有人的照片，当然包括

sentences.en: Obama, and then
sentences.zh: 奥巴马，还有当时的

sentences.en: Vice President Biden in the Situation Room, that secure
sentences.zh: 副总统拜登在战情室，那个安全的

sentences.en: White House room.
sentences.zh: 白宫房间里。

sentences.en: They were all watching on the screen as the Navy SEAL team that was sent to kill bin Laden was doing its work.
sentences.zh: 他们都在屏幕上看着被派去击毙本·拉登的海豹突击队执行任务。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And they made it out to be, this was going to be an end of an era.
sentences.zh: 他们把它渲染成一个时代的终结。

sentences.en: This was a threat that the United States had been pursuing,
sentences.zh: 这是美国一直在追捕的威胁，

sentences.en: Osama bin Laden, for a decade.
sentences.zh: 奥萨马·本·拉登，追了十年。

sentences.en: And they were bringing home justice, is the way it was put.
sentences.zh: 当时人们说，这是在伸张正义。

sentences.en: That after 10 years on the run, they had tracked down bin Laden and they had killed him.
sentences.zh: 在逃亡 10 年后，他们追踪到了本·拉登并杀死了他。

sentences.en: And that threat they made to believe was over.
sentences.zh: 他们以为那个威胁已经结束了。

sentences.en: But it wasn't.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: It wasn't at all.
sentences.zh: 根本不是。

sentences.en: Because Zawahiri, who had been the number two guy for all these years, was about to step out from the shadows and become al-Qaeda's new leader.
sentences.zh: 因为多年来一直担任二把手的扎瓦希里，即将从阴影中走出来，成为基地组织的新领导人。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《交易手册》报道商业和政策。

I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.

sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼等等。

sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: So, Eric, you reminded us that Bin Laden was killed
sentences.zh: 那么，埃里克，你提醒我们本·拉登是在

sentences.en: 11 years ago and that
sentences.zh: 11 年前被击毙的，而且

sentences.en: Al-Qaeda had not entirely gone away.
sentences.zh: 基地组织并没有完全消失。

sentences.en: So, what has
sentences.zh: 那么，这些年来

sentences.en: Zawahiri been doing all this time?
sentences.zh: 扎瓦希里一直在做什么？

sentences.en: So, what Zawahiri inherited when he took over the mantle of Al-Qaeda from Bin Laden was a network, a network of
sentences.zh: 扎瓦希里从本·拉登手中接过基地组织的衣钵时，继承的是一个网络，一个

sentences.en: Al-Qaeda affiliates around the world.
sentences.zh: 遍布全球的基地组织分支网络。

sentences.en: And Zawahiri, remember, is not the inspiring, glamorous figure that Bin Laden is, but he's a competent guy.
sentences.zh: 记住，扎瓦希里不像本·拉登那样是一个鼓舞人心、光芒四射的人物，但他是个能干的人。

sentences.en: He keeps this network together and does a couple of important things.
sentences.zh: 他把这个网络凝聚在一起，并做了几件重要的事情。

sentences.en: He allows these franchises greater autonomy than they had, but they're also recognizing that Zawahiri is who he is.
sentences.zh: 他给予这些分支机构比以往更大的自主权，但他们也清楚扎瓦希里的身份。

sentences.en: He is the long-time number two, now leader of Al-Qaeda.
sentences.zh: 他是长期以来的二把手，现在是基地组织的领导人。

sentences.en: They're operating within his strategic vision for the organization.
sentences.zh: 他们是在他的战略愿景下运作的。

sentences.en: So, even though it may not have been as dramatic a leadership style, it's a steady one, and the growth is steady around the world.
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管他的领导风格可能没那么戏剧化，但却很稳健，在全球范围内稳步增长。

sentences.en: Al-Qaeda is still drawing in members and creating new franchises in different places, trying to take advantage of where either there was little government or poor government,
sentences.zh: 基地组织仍在招募成员，并在不同地方建立新的分支机构，试图利用政府薄弱或治理不善的地方，

sentences.en: where they could come in and try and install their brand.
sentences.zh: 在那里他们可以介入并试图植入他们的品牌。

sentences.en: And Eric, are these franchises carrying out attacks?
sentences.zh: 埃里克，这些分支机构在发动袭击吗？

sentences.en: They are.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: In Somalia, for instance,
sentences.zh: 例如在索马里，

sentences.en: Shabab is the Al-Qaeda affiliate there.
sentences.zh: 青年党就是那里的基地组织分支。

sentences.en: They carry out a number of attacks, including one just a couple of years ago in 2020 that killed three Americans in Kenya.
sentences.zh: 他们发动了多次袭击，包括就在几年前的 2020 年，在肯尼亚杀害了三名美国人。

sentences.en: You had
sentences.zh: 还有

sentences.en: Al-Qaeda affiliates in Syria and in the Sahel portion of
sentences.zh: 在叙利亚和西非萨赫勒地区的

sentences.en: West Africa that are carrying out attacks against individuals, locals there.
sentences.zh: 基地组织分支，他们正在对当地个人发动袭击。

sentences.en: So, Eric,
sentences.zh: 所以，埃里克，

sentences.en: Al-Qaeda still is a threat, as you point out, but I feel like over the past decade, I heard much more about ISIS than Al-Qaeda.
sentences.zh: 正如你所指出的，基地组织仍然是一个威胁，但我感觉在过去十年里，我听到更多的是关于 ISIS 而不是基地组织。

sentences.en: So,
sentences.zh: 那么，

sentences.en: ISIS is formed basically from the ashes of the
sentences.zh: ISIS 基本上是从
